review_scope: Read-only source/plan/source-ZIP/hash and AST reconciliation; compressed actual traces hashed only, no actual payload decoded, no helper/replay/search/training/native execution.

source_level_preservation_argument.scope: Decoded finite object-root trace dictionaries, ordered fields, declared search/tree/children wrapper shape, all original string keys and JSON values; lists/tuples JSON-array normalization.
source_level_preservation_argument.ordinary_field_groups: Iterate all dictionary items in insertion order. Each maximal consecutive group without a designated special key is C-json encoded as a shallow dictionary; strip only its outer braces. Every original key/value is emitted once in its original relative position. No ordinary nested value or metadata/event field is omitted.
source_level_preservation_argument.special_fields: Before each designated field, flush the preceding group. Emit the original JSON-encoded key and colon at that exact position, then recursively emit its value. This does not presume search/tree/children occur last.
source_level_preservation_argument.mapping_punctuation: Single opening/closing braces; exactly one comma before every emitted group or designated field after the first. Empty dictionary is represented exactly.
source_level_preservation_argument.children: Emit opening/closing brackets and every child in original list order with one separating comma. Wrapper fields, tree nodes and child arrays use the same complete mapping argument recursively.
source_level_preservation_argument.induction: For finite tree depth, exact serialization of all child values gives exact serialization of each node, search mapping and root mapping, equal to full standard insertion-order compact ensure_ascii=False JSON serialization.
source_level_preservation_argument.byte_gate: Read exactly each emitted segment length from the immutable original gzip, compare every byte and both SHA streams, then require no trailing original byte. Errors or budget stops remain unknown/failed. Both ordinary and repaired pilot helpers require the entire gate, then compare original-byte SHA/length fingerprints.
source_level_preservation_argument.independence: Implementation imports only unchanged v1 loader/statistics and standard libraries; it does not import producer serializer or graph/search engine.

helper_changes.additional_control: Special fields deliberately appear midmapping at root/search/node/child wrapper positions.
helper_changes.pair_protocol: Both ordinary and repaired decoded objects must serialize byte-for-byte to the same frozen original; fingerprint field named canonical explicitly identifies full_original_compact_JSON_fingerprint_v2_not_sorted_canonical.

budgets.source_authoring_clock_scope: UTC elapsed since explicit source-writing marker, includes waits/interleaved work; not CPU effort. Earlier reading/design uninstrumented and unknown. Stored perf_counter marker not cross-process comparable on this host and not used as elapsed measurement.

activation.helpers: Root may launch only the seven-helper owner under its frozen plan after this source disposition.
activation.actual_evaluation: Still pending complete passed helper phase, exact receipt/pins, hash-bound activation-v2.json and root authorization. Direct worker CLI is not a security activation boundary.

limitations: Shallow C-encoded ordinary groups may be large; largest chunk is measured, not a hard cap or memory pass prediction.
Entire decoded reduced trace remains in memory; actual resource success requires owned lifetime receipts.
Special trace-container shapes are fail-closed; no general strict adversarial JSON parser claim.
Scope is complete JSON-value/byte preservation followed by unchanged graph/math replay, not an additional proof discovery or native acceptance.
Owner phase clock ends before final receipt write and source authoring; outer/startup/excluded costs must remain separately disclosed.
